scientific_limitations: Finite complete two-level posets with both antichain levels nonempty; unrestricted labelled accessibility relations; asymptotic uniform only as the upper level size tends to infinity. Not an isomorphism census, a count for arbitrary partial orders, or a logic-complexity bound. The rooted-fork special case is previously recorded and excluded from priority claims.
title: Forward-confluent relations on complete two-level intuitionistic frames: an exact census and uniform probability law
